area.name: Khadakwasla reservoir and south-west Pune, Maharashtra, India

provider: Copernicus Sentinel-2 (ESA), accessed through the Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC API and data API
asset: visual (true-colour B04/B03/B02 composite, 10 m native resolution)
rendering: Planetary Computer item bbox render at 1600x934 px, converted to WebP. No further colour adjustment.
attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025, processed by the Microsoft Planetary Computer.
licence: Copernicus Sentinel data terms: free, full and open access, attribution required.
limitations: A seasonal true-colour comparison of the same tile, orbit, platform and processing baseline. It is not a damage assessment, a flood map, or an analysed index. Bands were not downloaded, so NDVI and water extent are not computed.
